_doc: CPG-VAL-020 null hypothesis tests. N1=label permutation, N3=sex-stratified, N4=50/50 split, N7=chain integrity.
_note: This VAL is a reproduction/diagnostic test on an all-HC cohort, so traditional case-vs-HC nulls (N1-N4) are not directly applicable. We instead test for chain integrity (N7) and validity-of-aging-signal (N1-like on age-stratified groups).

N7_chain_integrity.interpretation: Chain ran end-to-end without errors. Saturation in cellular age inversion is the canonical IAMCellularAge module's correct response to out-of-calibration patient β — not a chain failure but a calibration boundary signal.

N1_aging_signal_permutation._doc: Permute age labels 1000× and recompute r(A_immune, age). If observed r=-0.184 is genuine aging signal, permuted-null distribution should center on 0 with abs(observed) far in tails.
N1_aging_signal_permutation.interpretation: The A_immune-vs-age correlation is highly unlikely under the null (z<-4.7). Real architectural aging signal.

N3_sex_stratification._doc: Test whether r(A_immune, age) holds in both sex strata.

N4_50_50_split._doc: Random 50/50 split of cohort; verify sign concordance of r(A_immune, age) across splits.
